author: NotJoseph_
body:
Ok so literally 5 minutes ago I was banned from the server from Kill Aura. I don't even have any hacks downloaded. Its actually pretty funny. But I know that I was not hacking. And please don't take into account the ban evading mistake because if you look at my Brother 1v1Me_ ban appeal you guys see the mistake or whatever. Now time for the story

I play avicus pretty often, Some say Im addicted, I am one of those players who likes to jitter click and click before Im in reach, I don't know why I do that I just always do. 

When I was little did something to my clicking finger so I changed my commands 

To hit I use shift -  I think tbh its a lot easier and you can get a lot more hits in
Use the arrow keys to move
S - shift
and the rest are the same. 

I don't know Its an honest mistake cause I had a pretty cool double kill so someone prob reported me.

Please understand. 

Thanks
-Kdefender03
